vetSays.line: 🛡️ Gladys, the person in their 40s, Mia and the man in his 40s met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Gladys, Mia, the man in his 40s are hurt.
🛡️ Caitlin, Rahim, Asan, Mia and Catalina met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Caitlin, Asan, Mia, Catalina are hurt.
🛡️ Andres, Caitlin, Gladys, Rahim and Asan met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Andres, Caitlin, Gladys, Rahim, Asan are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Asan just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mia just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Gladys, Rahim, Asan, Mia and Catalina met them at the door — 4 put down. Rahim didn't come back. Gladys, Asan, Mia, Catalina are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Caitlin just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Gladys just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Caitlin, Gladys, Asan, Mia and Aria met them at the door — 5 put down. Caitlin, Gladys, Asan, Mia are hurt.
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."
🛡️ Ximena met them at the door — 1 put down. Ximena is hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Asan just put down The Congregation... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Wanjiru taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Wanjiru passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.

Asan: "Asan and Rodrigo blooded the fourth draft's beasts — we all saw it on the cameras. But only 2 of us carry a weapon, and the fifth draft waits until 6 of us do. We need more hands armed, not more speeches."

📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
